name.en-US: St. John Baptist de la Salle
name.pt-BR: São João Batista de la Salle

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Raise up, we pray, teachers in your Church ready to devote themselves wholeheartedly to the human and Christian formation of the young.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Suscitai na vossa Igreja educadores que se dediquem de todo o coração à formação humana e cristã da juventude.

meta.face: A clean-shaven man of about sixty with an oval face and full cheeks — a long, straight nose with a fine ridge, round dark-brown eyes under softly arched brows, a rounded chin with a small dimple and a small, curved mouth in a gentle, kindly half-smile; soft grey hair brushed back and falling to the collar. Not thin or wasted, and the hair grey rather than snow-white.
meta.basis: The official portrait of the Founder, dated 1734 and attributed to Pierre Léger, kept in the Brothers' archives in Rome: clean-shaven, grey hair to the collar, a long nose, a gentle expression, the black habit with the white rabat.
